Heel/support positions are displaced below the common ground location, also visible from behind where shoe toes cannot explain the shift. A fixed metadata root does not repair this contact.
Processed light/dark views have clean transparent surroundings and no calibration tile or guide strokes.

The delivered frames retain the source redesign and its scale/contact defects. Declared fixed rectangles, common sampling scale and global alpha32 cleanup do not fit individual subjects or stencil their silhouettes.
